extraction: DERIVED INDEX. One row per system or catalogue that could pair an out-of-plane tracer with an in-plane rotation measurement. Every number in it is traceable to a manifested file in this directory.
measurement_or_model: INDEX / NAVIGATION AID. Not itself an observation; the measurement_or_model column records the label of the underlying data.
note: Answers the lane question directly: which entries pair an OUT-OF-PLANE tracer with IN-PLANE rotation for the SAME system. Headline: the Milky Way is the only system with both legs fully measured and free of any assumed halo (69 usable 3-D stream tracks, 33 of them full 6-D, against a 38-point rotation curve over 5.27-24.82 kpc). M31 and 24 ELVES hosts pair satellites with rotation. SAGA DR3 gives the largest clean out-of-plane satellite sample (378 satellites, 101 hosts, all with orientation) but has NO in-plane rotation for any host. Counter-rotators pair by construction, both components living in one galaxy.
